parameters.help_en: The name of the express synchronization group. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length, and can contain letters, Chinese characters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter or a Chinese character
parameters.help_zh: 极速同步组名称。同步组名称长度限制1~128个字符，可以包含大小写字母、中文、数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）或短划线（-），同时必须以大小写字母或者中文开头
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the express synchronization group. The description can be up to 255 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 极速同步组描述。长度限制为255个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The region where the OSS bucket resides
parameters.name: bucket_region

parameters.help_en:
The name of the bucket. Take note of the following items:

A synchronization group can be associated with only one OSS bucket. All changes made to the data in the bucket are synchronized to the local client.

If you have not created any shares connected to the OSS bucket, create a share between the file gateway and the OSS bucket first
parameters.help_zh:
Bucket名称。请注意：

一个同步组只能设定一个OSS Bucket，所有对该Bucket内数据进行的改动都会被同步至本地。

如果您还未创建任何连接至OSS Bucket的共享，请先创建文件网关与OSS Bucket之间的共享
parameters.name: bucket_name

parameters.help_en: The subdirectory of the bucket. If you want to synchronize data changes in a specific subdirectory of the bucket, specify the subdirectory
parameters.help_zh: Bucket子目录。如果您要对Bucket特定子目录内的数据改动进行同步，可以填写您需要的子目录
parameters.name: bucket_prefix

Code.description_en: The HTTP status code. A status code of 200 indicates that the request is successful
Code.description_zh: 状态码。状态码为200表示请求成功

ExpressSyncId.description_en: The ID of the express synchronization group

Message.description_en: The description of the request result

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
